feature: Size mode measures buttons, pills and cards
summary: Hovering or roughly boxing a button now measures the button: a big gradient pill with a glow (your Download for Mac pill reads 274 by 62), a button the same brightness as its page in another colour, a card under a soft shadow, at any size. The glow and the shadow are left out.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Open your capture of the download page (Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 18.43.43), or Tests/PhotonzRenderTests/Fixtures/download-pill-2x.png, which is a crop of it.

try.do: Press I for Measure, pick Size, and hover the round left end of the purple pill.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Hover a letter of Download for Mac: the outline still sits on the pill, 274 by 62.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press [ to step down to the words themselves (158 by 15), and ] to step back to the pill.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Drag a rough box round the pill that also crosses the small print under it, and let go.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Check the box measured the pill, 274 by 62, not the box you drew.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Hover a white card with a drop shadow, or a coloured button on a grey page, in any capture of your own.

evaluate: Does hovering anywhere on a button, its label included, outline the button you meant?
Does the outline land on the edge of the fill, never out in the glow or shadow?
Is starting on the button and pressing [ for its words the right way round on a label?
Does a rough box round a button snap to it as often as you expect, including when the box crosses nearby text?
Does hovering still feel instant on a full screen capture?
rough: No mock covers how Size mode reads the picture; nothing on screen changed apart from what it measures.

Pressing ] from the pill steps to a box that runs from the pill's top down into the line of small print under it: an older reading that pairs the pill's top with the small print. It was there before this change and is left in the task log.
A hover reads at most a million pixels of picture (about 700 by 350 points of card at 2x). Past that a big panel is read only by its straight edges, as before.
Your pill is 62.5 points tall in the capture; the readout rounds it to 62.
